parameters.name: Platforms
parameters.description:
Architecture for image building. Valid values:

*   `linux/amd64`
*   `linux/arm64`
*   `linux/386`
*   `linux/arm/v7`
*   `inux/arm/v6`

Default value: `linux/amd64`

parameters.name: PushName
parameters.description: The name of the push that triggers the building rule.

parameters.name: PushType
parameters.description:
The type of the push that triggers the building rule. Valid values:

*   `GIT_TAG`: tag push
*   `GIT_BRANCH`: branch push

parameters.name: RepoId
parameters.description: The ID of the image repository.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-repo-build-rule --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --repo-id crr-8dz3aedjqlmk0000 --dockerfile-location / --dockerfile-name Dockerfile --push-type GIT_BRANCH --push-name master --image-tag v0.9.5 --build-args UserName=Test --platforms linux/amd64 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateRepoBuildRule --region cn-hangzhou --PushType GIT_BRANCH --ImageTag 'v0.9.5' --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --BuildArgs.1 'UserName=Test' --PushName master --DockerfileLocation '/' --Platforms.1 'linux/amd64' --RepoId 'crr-8dz3aedjqlmk0000' --DockerfileName Dockerfile
